requirements.expectation: Freeze the two-level fixed Bot loop graph: outer max 2, inner max 3, judged outcomes, approval and exhaustion transitions.
Freeze the three-level fixed Human loop graph (outer 3, middle 2, inner 2) with judged outer outcomes and inner exhaustion only.
Reset the carrier, guarantee the Human, register the static-bearer native-tool Provider and the disposable release-domain worker Bot, then make the Bot public.
Validate every nested definition through the product CLI, create the state-machine group with manual worker binding, start its run and keep the run/session identifiers.
Replay one already-complete inner callback and prove the carrier neither creates a duplicate delivery nor branches the run again.
Program the scripted Judge with the exact nested Bot outcome sequence before the Bot story starts and clear the carrier between definitions.
Deliver the exact 15-step outer/inner path map, capture the early inner-approval delivery, replay its stale callback and assert the early break happened.
Emit and freeze the complete nested Bot completion marker with its 17/15/2 routing counts.
Verify the nested Bot graph shape: exactly two loops, 17 nodes, 15 completed, 2 skipped at outer 1/inner 3, and matching history output count.
Program the nested Human Judge sequence (repeat then done) and start the three-level Human story from its frozen definition.
Consume the pending Human queue as exactly one node at a time with loop depth 1..3, bounding path iteration and optionally returning loop context.
Prove inner-iteration context isolation: first iteration has no previous result, later iterations bind the exact previous execution/output and a stale node re-reply is rejected.
Finish the publish delivery and emit the complete three-level Human completion marker.
Read the Human-authenticated graph directly and prove the Bot runtime token cannot bypass it; three loops, 31 nodes, 21 completed, 10 skipped only in outer iteration 3.
Verify machine output history: every completed node publishes exactly one output whose execution metadata matches the graph, and skipped nodes never publish.
Require the public CLI, driver and Human arguments, run the Bot story then the Human story in fresh temporary definition directories, and always restore cleanup.

story_markers: Nested Bot: 17/15/2 routing, paths, history and stale callback verified
Nested Human: three levels, parent isolation, stale reply and outer subtree skip verified
